top_signals.title: Nvidia Is Not a Normal Company Having a CEO Issue: Everson
top_signals.summary: Carolyn Everson, a board member at Coca-Cola, Disney and Under Armour and a senior advisor at Permira, discusses how boards respond to allegations involving executives. Everson speaks with Romaine Bostick and Jess Menton on “The Close.” (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
